We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: In Beijing, defendant Liu directed others to cut down and purchase trees (poplar? 杨树) on land without a logging permit. The trees were on land contracted by her late husband. She was stopped after 113 trees cut. This is illegal logging. The relevant criminal charge in Chinese law is "非法采伐森林木材罪" which is under the category of "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪". In the provided label list, we have "故意毁坏财物" (intentional damage to property) and "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" etc. But illegal logging is considered "非法采伐森林木材罪" which is a type of "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪". The list does not have that exact phrase. The closest is "故意毁坏财物" (intentional destruction of property) or maybe "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) not relevant. Could be "故意毁坏财物". However illegal logging is a specific environmental crime, not listed. The list includes "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method harming public safety) not relevant. "放火" not. "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施" not. So likely they map to "故意毁坏财物". The act is intentional destruction of trees (property). So charge: "故意毁坏财物". Also maybe "非法采伐森林木材" but not in list. So answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>.
